transcript.text: Hi everyone, I wanted to get us together to go through the Brightline Mobile activation plan for the opening-night livestream on October 4. As part of the normal pre-launch sign-off, I need to review the plan against sponsorship contracts, broadcast traffic, and audience-data compliance before we lock the rundown and any public-facing materials. I'd like to walk through each element and make sure we're all aligned before I give my approval.
